QUESTS.desc: Little remains of Ankrahmun since the war of the djinns reduced it to ruins. The passage from Darashia is watched by a guard under the Caliph's strict orders — and he lets no one through without permission…
QUESTS.name: Access to Ankrahmun

QUESTS.desc: The wizard Alawar hid his treasure in a vault beneath the icy isles north of Carlin, trusting fierce minotaurs and treacherous magic fields to keep it safe…
QUESTS.name: Alawar's Vault Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 3 White Pearls, Broadsword, Dark Helmet, 4 Throwing Knives, Blank Rune, 33 gp, Key 4501, Key 4502, Key 4503

QUESTS.desc: On her voyage from Thais to Rookgaard, the explorer Amber left her precious notebook behind on a raft. She would surely value its safe return…
QUESTS.name: Amber's Notebook Quest

QUESTS.desc: The most infamous challenge in Tibiantis: four heroes, one chamber of demons, and a choice between legendary rewards. The old sign at the entrance offers the only welcome you'll get — come and die with your friends…
QUESTS.name: Annihilator Quest
QUESTS.rewards: One of the following: Demon Armor, Magic Sword, Stonecutter Axe, or a Present Box

QUESTS.desc: Poison is one of a young adventurer's deadliest foes. Rumor has it a remedy can be bartered — if you bring the right item to the right person…
QUESTS.name: Antidote Rune Quest

QUESTS.desc: Far off Venore's coast lies the island of Aruthang. The captain will sail you there — for a price few can afford. Those who prove themselves to the islanders will find that their generosity goes well beyond a ride on the steamboat…
QUESTS.name: Aruthang Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Dwarfen Helmet, Dwarven Armor, access to Aruthang steamboat, access to NPC

QUESTS.desc: A tropical fruit growing far from its home. Curiously, someone on the island may want it even more than you do…
QUESTS.name: Banana Quest
QUESTS.videoNote: Disclaimer: there is a second banana palm in the premium area of Rookgaard. Both palms share the same quest id, so you can only take the banana from one of them — and the free-side palm shown above is the recommended pick: reaching the premium one requires stacking three boxes, which are not that easy to find (or carry around) in Rookgaard.

QUESTS.desc: The orcs of Edron guard their finest equipment deep within their underground hideout — and they don't take kindly to visitors…
QUESTS.name: Barbarian Axe Quest

QUESTS.desc: Somewhere beneath Thais, a soldier's axe waits for an owner brave enough to claim it…
QUESTS.name: Battle Axe Quest

QUESTS.creatures: Snake, Rat, Troll, Orc, Minotaur, Bear
QUESTS.desc: Deep in the tunnels north of town, behind a locked door, a restless guardian watches over boxes that aren't his…
QUESTS.name: Bear Room Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Key 4601, Chain Armor, Brass Helmet, 12 Arrows and 40 gp
QUESTS.videoNote: Note: the first part of this walkthrough is shared with the Present Box Quest — both quests live in the same tunnels. The fade marks where the Bear Room route continues on its own.

QUESTS.desc: In the depths of Cyclopolis, north of Edron, the mightiest of giants hoard a treasure worthy of their size. Bring friends — behemoths don't share…
QUESTS.name: Behemoth Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 30k, Life Ring, 5 Small Diamonds, 5 Small Sapphires, 5 Small Rubies, 100 Power Bolts

QUESTS.desc: Even the fiercest berserkers of Edron's orc cave keep a small hoard of pearls and gold. Taking it from them is another matter…
QUESTS.name: Berserker Treasure Quest

QUESTS.desc: The witch Wyda knows the value of a rare herb that grows only near dead trees, deep in the Greenclaw Swamp. Finding it is dangerous; deciding what to do with it is up to you…
QUESTS.name: Blood Herb Quest

QUESTS.desc: There are signs that little Rookgaard was visited long before the Order of the Knights of Thais arrived — castaways brought in by the tide, explorers seeking respite, or pirates looking to hide their treasures. Either way, some of the island's caves sheltered what today are but faint traces of these outsiders' passing…
QUESTS.name: Captain Iglues Treasure Quest
QUESTS.req: Rope. Food is highly recommended, and an antidote rune is optional but can be useful.

QUESTS.desc: A dwarven garrison guards a valuable treasure in a circular room deep beneath Kazordoon's mines. They will defend it from all sides — literally…
QUESTS.name: Circle Room Quest

QUESTS.desc: Not every blade rests in a place of honor. This one lies where only the rats would find it…
QUESTS.name: Combat Knife Quest
Crystal Wand Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Crystal Wand, Double SD Rune, Twinkiller Rune (Book)

QUESTS.name: Dead Archer Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Bow, 5 Poison Arrows, Mana Fluid, Life Fluid

QUESTS.name: Deeper Fibula Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Elven Amulet, Dwarven Ring, Serpent Sword, 6 Small Diamonds, Time Ring

QUESTS.name: Desert Dungeon Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 100 Platinum Coins and a green bag with: Protection Amulet, Ring Of Healing, Magic Light Wand and Ankh

QUESTS.name: Djinn Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Ability to trade with the djinns

QUESTS.creaturesNote: Only one — unless more are roped up from beneath the floor.
QUESTS.desc: Some adventurer used to stash his loot under a loose board in the stable to the north, next to a strange note on the wall. He may have forgotten something when he left…
QUESTS.name: Doublet Quest
Draconia Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Ice Rapier, Serpent Sword, Stone Skin Amulet and Energy Ring

QUESTS.desc: A dying dragon found its way to Rookgaard — luckily it perished before it could do any real harm to the young local adventurers. Those brave enough to face its flames may still find something of great value within its corpse…
QUESTS.name: Dragon Corpse Quest
QUESTS.req: Rope, shovel and scythe. Food and/or life fluids are essential — facing the flames without them is certain death.

QUESTS.name: Dragon Tower Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 2 Small Sapphires, 30 Burst Arrows, 60 Poison Arrows, Bow, 1 Health Potion, 1 Mana Potion

QUESTS.name: Elvenbane Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Morning Star, Dwarven Shield, Mana Potion, Blank Rune, Spellbook, 2 Small Diamonds and 100 gp

QUESTS.name: Emperor's Cookies Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Key 3800, a bag with 20+7 cookies and Key 3801 and Key 3802

QUESTS.name: Fire Axe Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Red Spellwand, Life Ring, BP GFB, BP UH, Paralyze Rune, 2x Soulfire Rune, 4x Fire Bomb rune, 2x Energy Bomb Rune

QUESTS.name: Geomancer Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Small Sapphire, Small Diamond, Dwarven Ring

QUESTS.desc: Across a stone-guarded bridge, the goblins keep a temple to their crude gods — and a rather odd collection of offerings…
QUESTS.name: Goblin Temple Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 50 gp, 4 Snowballs, 5 Small Stones, Sandals, Pan and a Vial of Milk

QUESTS.name: Griffin Shield Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Griffin Shield, Dwarven Axe, Obsidian Lance

QUESTS.desc: A beautiful flower, in a rather inconvenient spot…
QUESTS.name: Honey Flower Quest
QUESTS.req: Rope. A few life fluids and at least one antidote rune are recommended.

QUESTS.name: Iron Helmet Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Iron Helmet, Sudden Death Rune, Leather Armor, Porgol's Strange Behaviour (Book), Worn Leather Boots, Longsword

QUESTS.creatures: Bug, Spider, Wolf, Poison Spider, Skeleton, Rotworm
QUESTS.desc: In the northeast of Rookgaard island, a sharp blade awaits whoever is brave enough to reach it…
QUESTS.name: Katana Quest
QUESTS.req: Rope and shovel. While not strictly required, a few life fluids are highly recommended.

QUESTS.name: Kingdom of Kormarak Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Brass Armor, Brass Helmet, Hatchet and 13 Throwing Stars

QUESTS.desc: A relic of the soldiers who served on the island long ago. One can still be earned — for the right price…
QUESTS.name: Legion Helmet Quest
Longsword Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Longsword, Mirror, 3 Blank Runes, Wooden Doll, Wedding Ring, 76 gp

QUESTS.name: Mad Mage Room Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Hat of the Mad, Stone Skin Amulet and Star Amulet in Quest boxes. Silver Dagger and some Mana Potions spawn in another chest in this room

QUESTS.name: Medusa Shield Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 5k, Blue Spell Wand, 2x BP UH, 2x BP HMM'S, BP Explosion

QUESTS.desc: The deepest, darkest corner of the island, spoken of only in whispers: a burning pit the locals call Minotaur Hell. Few descend; fewer return…
QUESTS.name: Minotaur Hell Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Carlin Sword, 4 Poison Arrows, 10 Arrows and a Fishing Rod

QUESTS.name: Mintwallin Cyclops Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Small Diamond, 2 Health Potions, Hatchet, Chain Helmet and a Chain Armor

QUESTS.name: Orc Shaman Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Magic Light Wand, Axe Ring and Blank Rune

QUESTS.name: Ornamented Shield Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Brown Bag containing Key 3702, Might Ring, Dragon Necklace, Spike Sword, Devious Dragons (Book), Ornamented Shield, Steel Helmet, Inkwell. Red Bag containing Time Ring, 5 Platinum Coins, Garlic Necklace, Spellbook, Lyre

QUESTS.name: Paradox Tower Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Up to two of the following: 10k gp, Wooden Wand, 32 Talons, Phoenix Egg

QUESTS.name: Parchment Room Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Brown Bag containing Key 6010, Bone, Stealth Ring, 2 Talons, Skull

QUESTS.desc: Sturdy tools are hard to come by on a frontier island. A certain shopkeeper will only part with his precious picks for high-quality goods…
QUESTS.name: Pick Quest
Postman Missions Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Cheaper parcels (10 gp), letters (5 gp), boat fares (10 gp cheaper). 6k discount in The Thieves Guild Quest. Use of locked mailboxes, Post Officer's Hat, Post Horn

QUESTS.name: Power Bolts Quest
QUESTS.rewards: 5 Power Bolts, 12 Burst Arrows, Two Handed Sword, The Dreammaster (Book), 6 Throwing Stars, Talon

QUESTS.name: Power Ring Quest
QUESTS.rewards: a Power Ring and a Bronze Amulet

QUESTS.desc: Somewhere in the dangerous tunnels, a brightly wrapped present box sits, oddly out of place. Who left it there, and for whom, nobody knows…
QUESTS.name: Present Box Quest
Purple Tome Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Tibia Map (Book), Fields of Glory Map (Book) and Purple Tome

QUESTS.name: Queen of the Banshees Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Boots of Haste, Amulet of Loss, Stealth Ring, Stone Skin Amulet

QUESTS.desc: Swift and elegant, a fencer's blade — abandoned in the least elegant place imaginable…
QUESTS.name: Rapier Quest

QUESTS.desc: Every hero's story starts with a humble blade. This one can be earned with a good deed rather than a good fight…
QUESTS.name: Short Sword Quest
Silver Brooch Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Silver Brooch, 2 Small Rubies, 3 Small Diamonds

QUESTS.name: Skull of Ratha Quest
QUESTS.rewards: White Pearl, 2 Black Pearls, Skull of Ratha, Wolf Tooth Chain, Dwarven Ring, 100 gp, Crystal Necklace

QUESTS.desc: A woodcutter's tool, not good enough for a weapon — yet, in the hands of a shrewd trader, worth more than many blades…
QUESTS.name: Small Axe Quest
Steel Helmet Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Steel Helmet, 47 gp, 56 gp, The Fox Is Out (Book)

QUESTS.desc: Sturdy legwear for those who plan on getting hit. A certain islander will part with a pair — if you bring what they fancy…
QUESTS.name: Studded Legs Quest

QUESTS.desc: A dependable shield for a rookie's arm. Its owner will trade it — for something you'd never expect a shield to cost…
QUESTS.name: Studded Shield Quest
Time Ring Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Time Ring, Elven Amulet, Crystal Ball

QUESTS.desc: Dark places outnumber the lit ones on this island. A little fire goes a long way…
QUESTS.name: Torch Quest
Triangle Tower Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Garlic Necklace, Dwarven Ring and 2 Small Sapphires

QUESTS.name: White Raven Monastery Quest
QUESTS.rewards: Blessed Ankh, Family Brooch, access to the Isle of the Kings
